questions.title: Longest increasing subsequence
questions.text:
Print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of the array.

Input: first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5); second line n integers.
Output: the length.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
starterCode.javascript:
const data = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);
// write your code here
